candidate: Six canonical-read statements owned by each verification pass; prototype removed after the bounded comparison.
measurement: Fresh supported CLI process and identical closed database copy per invocation; full command including GNU time wrapper, opening, query, output and exit. Builds and fixture copying excluded. Filesystem caches not dropped; one untimed pair per fixture.

environment.storage: virtio disk on shared host NVMe; 32 GiB job volume
environment.contention: shared desktop host; not a dedicated benchmark host

acceptance.order: baseline/candidate for even pairs, candidate/baseline for odd pairs
acceptance.stopping_rule: No extensions after results; abort on failure or timeout.
acceptance.rss_tolerance: Median and maximum increase <= max(10 percent, 2048 KiB)
acceptance.latency_tolerance: p90 and maximum increase <=10 percent on either fixture
